as_told.title: Lazar: a craft at Area 51 was found on the sea floor

plain: Bob Lazar is a man who says that in 1989 he worked on taking apart alien craft at a secret site called S4, near the Nevada military base known as Area 51. Lazar says a colleague named Barry Castilio told him that the craft he studied, which he calls the "sport model," came from an archaeological dig, and that the dig was in the water, not the desert. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, later repeats it as Lazar correcting himself: not an archaeological dig, but something the Navy found on the seafloor. If true, it would mean the craft came out of the ocean and the Navy handed it over.
